# sonarqube_quality_gate_status (Data Source)

The quality gate status of a project's last analysis, for its main branch or a given branch or pull request. Use it in preconditions and checks, e.g. to hold a deployment while the gate fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_quality_gate_status" "api" {
  project = "example-api"
  branch  = "release/2.4"
}

# Hold the deployment while the quality gate fails.
resource "terraform_data" "deploy" {
  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = data.sonarqube_quality_gate_status.api.status == "OK"
      error_message = "The quality gate of example-api release/2.4 is ${data.sonarqube_quality_gate_status.api.status}."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project key.

### Optional

- `branch` (String) Branch name. Defaults to the main branch.
- `pull_request` (String) Pull request ID.

### Read-Only

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Evaluated conditions, sorted by metric. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `id` (String) `project`, `project:branch` or `project#pull_request`.
- `ignored_conditions` (Boolean) Whether conditions on coverage and duplication were ignored because little code changed.
- `status` (String) `OK`, `ERROR`, or `NONE` when not analyzed yet.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Read-Only:

- `actual_value` (String) Measured value.
- `comparator` (String) `LT` or `GT`.
- `error_threshold` (String) Threshold of the condition.
- `metric` (String) Metric key.
- `status` (String) `OK` or `ERROR`.
